source.text_layer: partial (CAR disclosure p.2-3 only; statements scanned)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2026 = year to date). File named TIPLIFE (Dhipaya Life Assurance). Hybrid file: CAR disclosure p.2-3 has a text layer, the reviewed statements (EY) are scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Units differ: the SCI (p.8) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht (FY2025 notes were in Baht). No PAA business. Issued contracts are reported in two portfolio groups: note 5 (ordinary and others) and note 6 (credit group). Revenue and expenses from note 4 total column (p.15, 3 months). CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 5.2 (p.19) and 6.2 (p.24); new business = 5.3 (p.21) + 6.3 (p.26) totals. Each summed item records the note 5 page; the heading names the note 6 page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column; change in estimates nil this quarter). Other revenue = รายการอื่น (note 4). Other expense = other operating expenses (no separate other finance cost line). In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
